readout_other: LFP and EMG sleep scoring (TST, NREM/REM ratios, relative power, sample entropy)
direction_notes: TUS increased the NREM sleep ratio and decreased the REM ratio in healthy mice without changing total sleep time; in sleep-disordered AD mice it increased total sleep time; effects depended on sleep state.
safety_notes: Temperature rise estimated by calculation as about 9.2e-3 degrees C.

timing.protocol_description: 500 kHz, PRF 1 Hz, DC 5%, stimulation duration 50 ms. The stimulation pattern was 5 min of stimulation followed by a 5-min interval for a total of 25 min for 7 days.

flags.reason: Strain totals only (C57BL/6N 56, APP/PS1 12); these include controls and the auditory check animals, so group sizes listed rather than a count of sonicated mice.
Text calls 50 ms 'stimulation duration'; with 5% duty cycle and 1 Hz PRF this is the pulse duration (resolved by arithmetic), while the sonication is 5 min blocks.
5 min of stimulation then 5 min interval, 25 min total per day for 7 days; 300 s per block.
Pressure and intensities given without stating domain.
Same parameters as the motor cortex exposure; hippocampus recordings were in subsets (n=6).
Control group had amplifier-transducer connection disconnected.
Separate experiment: 6 healthy mice stimulated with a specific ultrasound to which they had no auditory response (Supplementary Fig. S5).
Recorded as 7 from 'for 7 days' (daily stimulation); LFP recorded on days 1, 3 and 7.
